assumptions: The stepped footprint is mirrored from the drawing per field correction 2026-10-07: S01-S02 start 9 m behind X1 (the drawing shows the notch at S03-S04, which is wrong); the 1.5 m roof overhangs at both ends are not modelled.
Beds and both screen layers are repeated in every span; partial layouts and the central cross aisle are simplified.

Eave 5.0 m is dimensioned on drawing pages 6-10; ridge 7.5 m and the circular pointed-arch radius were measured from the vector section geometry (pages 6-10, 1/150). Both are design-drawing values, not field-surveyed.
Trusses and gutters are visual connecting members using visual_frame_radius, not fabrication sections.
Bed z is the bottom elevation; row centers divide each span into equal-width cells.
Bed width, height, elevation and end margins are unverified visual defaults from the specification, not measured dimensions.
The roof uses the drawing's two-arc pointed profile (R 8.193 m per half-span); the circular visual frame section remains a visualization approximation.
Equipment existence is drawing-supported (pages 30-31); end-aisle placement is a provisional visualization arrangement, not a surveyed installation location.
Drive dimensions, rack travel, pinion/drum rotation and curtain routing are approximate visual relationships, not calibrated mechanics.

Environment sensor positions are unverified placeholders, except SOLAR_01 whose location (S01 rear end, above the cover) is an operator report 2026-10-07 with an approximate mounting point; no real PLC tags are assigned.

Screen heights (4.8 m shade, 4.55 m diffuse) sit below the 5.0 m eave, so interior clipping leaves the full span width. Each screen layer has two halves per span that run out from both gutters and meet at the span centre (operator report 2026-10-07); one opening percent drives both halves.
Crops are capped at 45 visual instances per bed; dashboard LOD does not represent a crop census.
Sidewall lower height, door dimensions and one-sided service zoning are approximate visualization choices, not surveyed dimensions.
Drawing X1 is mapped to Front at world X=-length/2 and X23 to Rear at world X=+length/2; the doorway stays in the Y4-Y3 region and, with the mirrored notch, lies on the X1 face.

eave_height.note: Dimensioned G.L-to-gutter height on the design drawing; not field-surveyed

ridge_height.note: Measured from vector section geometry at 1/150; not dimensioned or field-surveyed

greenhouse.span_start_offsets_source: Field correction 2026-10-07 (operator): the 9 m x 16 m front notch is on the other side from drawing pages 2, 4, 25, 30. Spans S01-S02 run 88.5 m from X3; spans S03-S04 run 97.5 m from X1. The doorway position (Y3-Y4 region) is unchanged and now sits on the X1 face.

roof.arch_source: Vector arcs on pages 6-10: each half-span is a circular arc, fit residual 0 mm

roof_vents.source: Farm operator report 2026-09-30: left/right independent ridge vents per span, 1.2 m wide, continuous length leaving 1 m at each end. Drawing pages 4/9/11 confirm two leaves per ridge (plan width 1.21 m, continuous through the X11-X12 motors). Operator report 2026-10-07: fully open (100 %) the leaf makes 100-120 deg with the vertical ridge post (measured from the post's downward direction); 110 deg chosen provisionally. The loader converts this to the leaf rotation from closed using the configured roof profile (about 40.5 deg).
roof_vents.assumption: Opening angle is taken as linear in opening percent (0-100% -> 0-max rotation); the operator confirmed only that the angle increases with percent. Vent length follows each span's length minus the 1 m end clearances.

placement.note: Provisional end aisle preserves all 20 beds; not the exact equipment location on drawing pages 30-31. In end_service_strip mode X/Y are derived from the current footprint; x/y apply only in absolute mode.
